pages.title: Finding Platinum
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 80. Veins target up to 4 blocks, with 3 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 4.

pages.title: Working Platinum
pages.text: Smelt Platinum Ore or Platinum Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 998 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 9.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 3.2.$(br)Enchantability: 30.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 4, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 30.$(br)Extra full-set health: 8.0 HP.

pages.title: Armor: Purification
pages.text: Purifies negative effects like Weakness, Slowness and Poison to their positive counterparts.

pages.title: Weapon: Cathartic Strike
pages.text: Extra cathartic damage will be dealt to undead enemies as well as setting them on fire.

pages.title: Equipment: Flawless
pages.text: Tools become unbreakable when equipped in the main hand. This trait does not make Platinum armor unbreakable.
